positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.locationName: San Francisco, California, United States · On-site

positions.title: Mobile Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Implemented custom feedback channels with Firebase Remote Config.
• Ported features, trading tools and added multi-theme support to Android tablets and iPads.
• Worked along with designers for UI refreshments.
• Assisted in the implementation of trading alert subscriptions.
• Assisted in implementation of notification system using Firebase Cloud Messaging.

positions.title: Test Automation Developer Intern
positions.description:
• Improved and validated existent tools to speed up testing(6x faster).
• Developed C# program to generate reports from existent test data.
• Added automation support for test steps

positions.title: Embedded Systems Software Developer Intern
positions.description:
• Multithreaded TCP/IP socket application for transceiver simulations.
• Built new features for C# applications.
• Positive customer feedback on features rolled out to production.
• Implemented and documented procedures for processing sensor data.
• Used Shell Scripts to develop an automated build system for transceivers’ firmware.

positions.title: Camera Hardware Intern
positions.description:
• Researched and tested several camera modules for face recognition systems.
• Used Raspberry Pis for interfacing to some of the camera modules.

educations.schoolName: Universidad Tecnológica de La Habana "José Antonio Echeverría"​, CUJAE
